annotation_method.authorization: the evaluated authorization stored in each exact trajectory row and bound to the replayed hold
annotation_method.authorization_reservation: separate historical ownership replay capped by the applied lease decision_event_seq; exact journal payload and evaluated authorization preserved
annotation_method.camera: three original PNG files captured at one physics frame
annotation_method.ground_truth: post-run map overlay for evaluation/media only; never a control input
annotation_method.hold_scope: HOLD/emergency requires zero drive input and retained generation/tile-hash binding; scope goal/route may be pending, ungranted candidates; navigation requires matching reserved goal/route
annotation_method.reservation: time-bounded journal view: events with sim_time <= capture sim_time; events with later timestamps excluded; ordering between capture and reservation events sharing the same timestamp is not established
annotation_method.trail: past and current exact camera-frame trajectory joins only
annotation_method.trajectory: both full-rate trajectories joined by exact physics_frame and sim_time_s; no interpolation

ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 8.1-full_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
omissions: Per-frame authorization, reservation tile arrays, and pose annotations remain in the complete original provenance.
Individual PNG path records are omitted; every capture's three source PNG hashes and exact physics time remain in this index.
provenance_self_hash: excluded; the supplement manifest binds this file
record_kind: compact index; complete original generation record retained unchanged in the G3b postprocess supplement

encoding.decode_verification: ffprobe dimensions/frame counts and full FFmpeg null decode passed
encoding.gif: up to 120 uniformly spaced original capture indices; 640x360, 10 fps, 128 colors
encoding.mp4: all original 1 Hz captures at 10 fps; libx264 medium CRF21 yuv420p faststart

representative_selection.rule: maximize simultaneous navigate state, then reservation generations, then midpoint proximity

scope: portfolio media from one validated qualification/pilot run; not primary comparison or production safety evidence
source_kind: actual synchronized Isaac Sim RGB plus validated post-run ground truth and G3 reservation/authorization journals; no generated imagery
